title: National cultural workers' protest for work and government support
location: Observed: largo do Estádio da Várzea, Praia (Santiago), and Praça Dom Luís, Mindelo (São Vicente). Other announced venues unverified.
organizer: Cultural agents' collective; Batchart identified as Praia spokesperson, Samira Pereira as Mindelo group adviser; formal national organizer unspecified.
participants_original: No actual total in opened bodies. PANA search-only/blocked report says 'várias dezenas' across parts of archipelago; Mindelo adviser could not specify expected number.
threshold_50_evidence: Unresolved: several dozen is search-only and ambiguous around50; no actual estimate from opened contemporary bodies. Seven announced venues cannot be added as people.

start_date.summary: January14 Mindelo report and January15 report describing Thursday afternoon establish actual January14 gathering, replacing the planned January12 date.

location.summary: Mindelo square and Praia stadium forecourt are observed; other islands are announcements only.

scope.summary: Sources describe a nationally coordinated collective action; venues retained together.

organizer.summary: Named local spokesperson/adviser; national formal structure unreported.

demands.summary: Workers requested state attention, ability to resume cultural work and livelihoods under pandemic restrictions.

participants.summary: No actual tally in read body; PANA size stays search-only and not an asserted threshold.

state_response.summary: Minister criticized action and referenced aid/eased rules; formal reception or explicit satisfaction attributable to this protest unestablished. Rule changes alone do not establish accommodation.

episode_unit.summary: Announcement recalls October18 2020 cultural action. A new January14 gathering is established; the original campaign/new-action boundary is unresolved without the additional Procedure.

notes: Actual Jan 14 gathering body-verified. Size also pending. Oct 18 recalled action is historical context, no continuous occupation established; not duplicated as January continuation. No claims of official approval.
open_questions: Verify actual>=50 participants without summing announced venues.
Resolve Oct2020/Jan2021 episode boundary under original additional Coding Procedure.
Follow physical end and government response; artist grants/regulation may predate or be independent of protest.

title: INE workers demonstrate for government publication of staff statutes
location: Outside Instituto Nacional de Estatística, Praia, Santiago
organizer: INE workers and SISCAP; union president Eliseu Tavares
participants_original: Cerca de 60 trabalhadores do INE, reported by Ailson Martins/Rádio Morabeza in Expresso das Ilhas.
threshold_50_evidence: Opened contemporary article explicitly reports approximately60workers participating in this demonstration; supports provisional>=50 without exact bounds.

start_date.summary: Dated Jan29 contemporary report says workers demonstrated that day. December30 source only threatened future action.

location.summary: Contemporary body places demonstration outside INE in Praia.

scope.summary: Single institution-front gathering reported; no national organization established.

organizer.summary: INE workers and SISCAP represented by Eliseu Tavares.

demands.summary: Government approval and publication of human-resource instruments, including staff statute and careers/pay plan.

participants.summary: Approximately60 actual participants; point estimate, not numeric bounds.

state_accommodation.summary: Official INE newsletter records publication of requested Staff Statute and Framework through Portaria11/2021 on February2, answering workers' concerns. Specific demand met; minister's phone promise alone does not qualify.

state_response_other.summary: Article does not establish six other responses; unknown preserved.

episode_unit.summary: December threat is not an assembly. September retrospective says February3 strike cancelled after agreement; no February continuation inferred. January29, March31 and April15 manifestations need original campaign episode rules.

notes: January29 is the actual gathering in this record. Later statute publication shows demand satisfaction, not physical protest end. March and April actions are context only. Retrospective chronology is distinguished from contemporary occurrence evidence.
open_questions: Apply missing additional Coding Procedure to January/March/April recurring INE manifestations.
Find physical protest end; do not use Feb2policy publication or lastnews as end.
Verify original statutory instrument and contemporaneous cancellation agreement; official newsletter account attributed.
